description:
Get details about mailbox usage.

TIP: Gets mailbox usage details per user. The period parameter must be one of: D7, D30, D90, D180. Returns CSV data with userPrincipalName, displayName, storageUsedInBytes, issueWarningQuotaInBytes, prohibitSendQuotaInBytes, itemCount, lastActivityDate.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-mailbox-usage-report
